name: Issue 2746: Runic Omen empowers Runeblade after its 3rd cast
contract: Runic Omen 705580 reads 'Every 3rd cast of Runeblade now deals $705596s1% increased damage.' Effect 0 is a
PROC_TRIGGER_SPELL of 520285, ProcChance 100, but Spell.dbc gives 705580 itself ProcFlags 0, so the aura
never registered a proc and 520285 never applied on any Runeblade cast. Runeblade (707141-707148,
573444-573447) is the only family 38 spell with mask2 0x40000 (DmgClass melee); 520285 carries its own
StackAmount 3 (DurationIndex 8, 15 sec), so once the proc fires on every Runeblade cast the native aura
system stacks it by 1 per cast, capped at 3 -- the 'every 3rd cast' counter already lives in the DBC record.
520285's own effect 1 is SPELL_EFFECT_DUMMY with EffectTriggerSpell 705596: aura_ascension_runemaster_runic_
omen_empower reads that on every cast of 520285, and once the counter has just reached 3 stacks it removes
520285 and casts 705596, a self-contained ADD_PCT_MODIFIER (+30%, family 38 mask2 0x40000 = Runeblade, 10
sec window) that is the tooltip's 'deals X% increased damage' payoff. Expected: the 1st and 2nd Runeblade
cast leave 520285 at 1 and 2 stacks with no change to Runeblade's damage modifier; the 3rd cast removes
520285, applies 705596, and raises Runeblade's SPELLMOD_DAMAGE modifier from 100 to 130.

steps.label: SETUP: Runeblade's damage modifier starts at 100
After the 1st cast the counter has 1 stack
After the 1st cast Runeblade's damage modifier is unchanged
After the 2nd cast the counter has 2 stacks
After the 2nd cast Runeblade's damage modifier is unchanged
CONTRACT: the 3rd cast consumes the counter
CONTRACT: the empower buff is granted
CONTRACT: Runeblade's damage modifier rises to 130
